full_judgment:
This Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party Nos.1 and 2 to show cause as to why the judgment and decree dated 22-8-2005 passed by the Court of Additional District Judge and Bankruptcy Court, Chittagong, in Money Appeal No.5 of 2002 dismissing the appeal of the defendant Nos.1 and 2 thereby affirming the judgment and decree dated. 24-11-2001 passed by the 2nd Court of Joint District Judge, Chittagong, decreeing the suit of the plaintiff in Money Suit No.968 of 1984 should not be set aside and /or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. The present opposite parties as plaintiff filed a Money suit against the present petitioners for a decree of Taka 1,53,725.69. 

 5. The trial Court decreed the suit. 

 6. Being aggrieved thereby, the defendants preferred appeal before the District Judge, Chittagong, which was transferred to the Court of the Additional District Judge and Bankruptcy Court, Chittagong, who dismissed the appeal and affirmed the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court. 

 10. I have heard the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners and perused the revisional application along with other materials on record. It appears that the present opposite parties as plaintiffs filed a Money suit against the present petitioners praying for a decree of Taka 1,53,725.69, as because 16.578 metric tons of inedible tallow as was carried by the vessel named `MT Botany Trojan' were short-landed for which the defendants are to compensate for C&F cost of the shortage quantity amounting to Taka 1,52,123.50 along with other costs. The defendants contested the suit. The trial Court decreed the suit and on appeal, the Court of appeal below affirmed the Judgment and decree passed by the trial Court. 

 14. For the reasons stated above, the Rule is made absolute. The judgments and decrees passed by the Courts below are set aside.
